item.title: WATCH: “Batting lineup suffers,” Rohit Sharma addresses Suryakumar Yadav’s prolonged lean patch ahead of T20 World Cup
item.description: Former No. 1-ranked T20I batter Suryakumar Yadav has been struggling for runs lately. His form is a cause of concern for the Indian team heading into the T20 World Cup 2026 on home soil. Suryakumar’s batting numbers have fallen drastically ever since assuming India’s T20I captaincy. He managed to score only 218 runs across 21 matches and 19 innings in 2025, averaging just over 13, with the best score of 47* to his credit. item.title: Daryl Mitchell dethrones Virat Kohli to become the new no.1 ranked ODI batter in latest ICC rankings
item.description: New Zealand batter Daryl Mitchell, thanks to his Player of the Series performance in the recent three-match ODI series against India, has become the new no. 1 ranked ICC ODI batter. This update was released by ICC on January 21, 2026. Daryl Mitchell hammered 84, 131*, and 137 in the three ODIs against India in Baroda, Rajkot, and Indore, respectively. item.title: “Don’t be surprised…,” Michael Clarke expects Shubman Gill to take over India’s T20I captaincy after World Cup
item.description: Shubman Gill was the notable omission from India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad announced last month. He looked to be a sure-shot for the marquee event after his return to the format and being given vice-captaincy and the opener's role. However, the 26-year-old struggled to make an impact with the bat, scoring 291 runs in 15 matches at an average of 24.25 and a strike-rate of 137.26. item.title: “You are being stubborn”- R Ashwin tells Ravindra Jadeja to try variations in his bowling; asks him to follow Virat Kohli's carefree game
item.description: Former India spinner R Ashwin asked Ravindra Jadeja to stop being stubborn and reinvent his bowling career if he wants to save his ODI career going forward. Ashwin asked Jadeja to follow Virat Kohli and shed inhibitions and enjoy his game going forward. Ashwin added that it's difficult to persuade him because his beliefs about bowling have become so entrenched as a result of his previous success. item.title: "I've learnt from my mistakes”- Harry Brook says he has to ‘regain trust’ of England players after New Zealand nightclub incident

item.title: “Not feasible to make changes,” ICC rejects Bangladesh’s plea to play T20 World Cup 2026 matches out of India
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday (January 21) issued a statement, confirming that there would be no changes to the original schedule of the Men's T20 World Cup 2026, and Bangladesh will have to play their Group C matches in India. The decision was taken following an ICC Board meeting via video conference. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “I don't feel it's high risk,” Abhishek Sharma reflects on his approach after match-winning 84 in 1st T20I
item.description: Abhishek Sharma starred with the bat in India’s 48-run victory over New Zealand in the first T20I at Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium, Nagpur on Wednesday (January 18). The left-handed opener slammed 84 off 35 balls with 5 fours and 8 sixes to lay the foundation of India’s mammoth score of 238/7 in 20 overs. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “The way he carries himself,” Suryakumar Yadav hails Abhishek Sharma’s heroics in Nagpur T20I
item.description: India skipper Suryakumar Yadav praised his team's batting resilience, recovering from 25/2 in the powerplay to rack up a massive 238/7 on the board during the first T20I against New Zealand in Nagpur on Wednesday (January 18). Opener Abhishek Sharma stole the show with the bat, smashing 84 off 35 balls with 5 fours and 8 sixes.
